page.layout: One printed plate, no text columns. At the top, a banner across the full width with a caption. Below it, 12 round medallions in 4 rows of 3, each with a small circular inscription. No marginal text.
page.notes: Engraved plate, not a text page. The scan is too low in resolution to read the banner caption or the medallion inscriptions. Only the outlines and the rough layout of the medallions can be seen. The inscriptions in the bottom two rows look like short circular legends, but I cannot read any letters with confidence, so I have not transcribed them. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. The page is slightly skewed and the paper is stained.
